[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38870378/268336e77aed2fd09e4b9bf45b2df67a69920e7e.png[/img]

Thank you to all who downloaded HTMN! demo I hope you are having fun with it! I'm going to continue to work hard on the game as soon as I publish it's prequel [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1610890/Boneys_Research_On_Humans/]Boney's Research On Humans![/url] starring the lovely and helpful skeleton, for HTMN I'm planning on working on the campaign and changing up a little bit of the core mechanichs of saving the neighbors to make it more intense.

I'll keep you updated on my [url=https://twitter.com/CarlosGHeron]Twitter [/url]and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYL-AqFcxgRrzaYG6r2Ta6Q]Youtube Channel[/url] so follow me if you are into that, have lovely week!
